text:
In the absence of other tumor involvement (lymph node involvement or distant metastasis), code the lobe or segment involvement as follows:

- If multiple lobes (such as the Caudate lobe and the Left Lobe) are involved, code 2 (Regional). If multiple segments (such as 5 and 6 in the right lobe) in the same lobe are involved, this would be multiple tumors within one lobe, code 1 (Localized).

The liver is divided into several lobes as defined below.

Caudate lobe: Segment 1
Quadrate lobe: Segment 4b
Left lobe: Segments 2, 3, 4a
Right lobe: Segments 5, 6, 7, 8

1 Localized only (localized, NOS)

- Confined to liver, NOS
- Single tumor (one lobe) WITH or WITHOUT vascular invasion
- Multiple (satellite) nodules/tumor confined to one lobe WITH or WITHOUT vascular invasion
